_README: Curated np- -> real БУЛСТАТ bridge for natural-person contractors.
One feed publishes a person ЕГН (encoded np-<hash of their name> so the ЕГН is never
stored - see scripts/procurement/supplier_identity.ts); the other publishes their real
БУЛСТАТ. Same person, keys that can never match, so the two feeds look like different
CURATED, NOT DERIVED. 18 entries out of 104 np- keys. A wrong bridge merges two people
public-money totals, so this set is enumerated and reviewed rather than computed from a
threshold at runtime - the same convention as amount_overrides.ts and the officials
re-slug maps. Candidates came from an exact match on the normalised contractor name,
with placeholder EIKs (^0{6,}[0-9]{1,3}$ - 000000001 alone carries 9 unrelated names
including "Elsevier B. V.") excluded. Note tr_companies is NOT a usable filter here:
sole-trader БУЛСТАТ registrations are absent from the commercial-register feed.
